# teams_guest_meeting_configuration (Resource)

Manages the GuestMeetingConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsGuestMeetingConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `allow_external_participant_give_request_control` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowExternalParticipantGiveRequestControl parameter.
- `allow_ip_video` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowIPVideo parameter.
- `allow_meet_now` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMeetNow parameter.
- `allow_multiple_screenshare` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowMultipleScreenshare parameter.
- `allow_participant_give_request_control` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowParticipantGiveRequestControl parameter.
- `allow_transcription` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowTranscription parameter.
- `live_captions_enabled_type` (String) Maps to the -LiveCaptionsEnabledType parameter.
- `screen_sharing_mode` (String) Maps to the -ScreenSharingMode parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
